messages:
emma (docs): quick note  spotted some broken relative fragment links after the migration: links like `../devportal#auth-flow` resolve to `.../devportal#AuthFlow` (capitalization + camelcase) and linkcheck marks them 404. can we sync on approach?
aj (devex): ugh. is this from the new remark-slug behavior or something in our URL rewrites? paste an example path pls.
emma (docs): example: source file `docs/guides/auth.md` contains `[auth flow](../devportal#auth-flow)` but built page has `<h2 id="AuthFlow">` (camelCase id) so anchor mismatch. curl to the preview returns 200 for page but 404 for anchor.

ci-bot: linkcheck: ERROR broken anchor at /guides/auth -> target /devportal#auth-flow (resolved target /devportal#AuthFlow)  1234 linkcheck-id: lc-2026-04-11-09.

raj (eng): sounds like slugifier changed behavior to preserve camelCase fragments from code samples. two fixes: normalize slugify to kebab-case canonical or add a client-side JS fallback that inspects anchors and redirects.
aj (devex): client-side fallback is low-effort: on page load, if location.hash doesn't match any id, try a few heuristics (lowercase, kebab-case, PascalCase). But I'd rather fix at build time.

lila (i18n): build-time normalization better, but we must consider translations: camelCase may appear in code sample headings that translators keep. For i18n pages, client-side fallback could be preferable to avoid changing locale urls.
emma (docs): proposal: 1) canonicalize all generated heading ids to kebab-case (lowercase, hyphens) during docusaurus build 2) emit a small client-side helper that maps legacy id variants to the kebab id so external bookmarks still work 3) run i18n scan to ensure we don't break translated anchors

aj (devex): agree. implement slugify hook that forces kebab-case. I can add a `createSlug` plugin in the docusaurus config and a tiny snippet for backwards compatibility: `if (!document.getElementById(hash)) { try variants... }`.

raj (eng): I'll add a post-build verifier that compares `source` inferred anchors vs built ids and lists mismatches in `build/anchor-audit.json`. we only emit client-side mappings for mismatches to keep the runtime helper small.

ci-bot: preview build available at https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/pr-1425  linkcheck shows reduced failures (5 -> 1).
emma (docs): PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1425  contains slugify hook + audit + small compatibility script. please review: aj for slug plugin, raj for auditor, lila for i18n risk.
aj (devex): will review this afternoon. if tests pass we can enable kebab-case for new builds and keep the compatibility script for 2 weeks.
lila (i18n): will run audit across `i18n/*/docs` and flag pages where manual review is needed.
emma (docs): thanks. aim: land by Friday and monitor linkcheck for 48h before removing client-side helpers. ping me with any regressions. :sparkles:
